_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), series MKL1N SET-1. 24 page images: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions + Hindi Q1-2, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22, each odd index 3-21 being the Hindi of the page after it (odd-page tops checked: all Hindi, no English overflow); idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Printed instructions confirm sci80_2026: Section A Biology (30) Q1-16, Section B Chemistry (25) Q17-29, Section C Physics (25) Q30-39, marks printed per question, every one matching the sci80_2026 table. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 2-11) for a bare OR: Q11, 15(c), 16, 27, 28(c), 29, 34, 38(c), 39 = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Case studies are Q15 (Biology), Q28 (Chemistry) and Q38 (Physics), each labelled (a), (b), (c)(i) OR (c)(ii); no 'Case Study' heading is printed, and the lead-in lines ('Answer the following questions :', 'Read the following passage and answer the questions given below :') are left out of context, as are the 'Directions :' labels before the assertion-reason instructions. All 20 MCQ / assertion-reason answers (Q1-9, Q17-24, Q30-32) are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page images; each re-derived, 20 agree, Q6 flagged for wording. No void, grace or either-of-two note anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are ordinary full stops (Q34: 0.01 cm, 1.0 cm; Q38: 1.5 m). Q20 option (C), a carbonyl group drawn with O double-bonded below the C, is typed with \underset as the Chemistry papers do. Opener of series 31/1: nothing skipped.

questions.context: Most of metals occur in combined state in form of ores. Carbonate ores are converted into oxides by calcination and sulphide ores by roasting. Oxides are reduced with suitable reducing agent like carbon to get free metal. Highly reactive metals like – Al, Mg are also used as reducing agents to obtain metal from their oxides. Most reactive metals are obtained by electrolytic reduction of their molten ores. Alloying is a very good method of improving the properties of a metal. We can get desired properties by this method. The electrical conductivity and melting point of an alloy is less than that of pure metals.

questions.context: Lenses can form different types of images depending upon their focal length and position of object. A convex lens can create real, inverted or virtual, erect images, while a concave lens forms only virtual and diminished images. The focal length determines the power of lens. Convex lenses have positive focal length while concave lenses have negative focal length by convention. When lenses are placed together, their combined power is determined by the sum of their individual powers. Ray diagrams help to visualize how light converges or diverges through lens to form an image.
